messages:
samira: Hey team 1 first day! I just tried to open Redwood Console (staging) to check feature flags for the demo app and I get a 403 on /flags. Can someone point me to who owns flag admin perms?

matt: welcome Samira :wave: pinging infra-ops and alice 1 alice manages flag ops usually. what path are you using?

samira: /orgs/redwood/staging/flags/list 1 my console shows the nav but clicking flags yields the 403 page with 'insufficient permissions'.

alice: @samira 1 do you see the "Request access" button in the top-right? If yes, request and add me as reviewer. If not, you probably need JIT role mapping for the new hire group.

samira: I don't see a request button. I tried incognito too.

onboarding-bot: Hi Samira! I noticed you're in the "new-hires" Okta group but not in the "flag-admins:staging" role. Submit a support ticket with subject "JIT map missing for Samira" to infra-ops to request temporary admin. See https://redwood.internal/onboard for steps.

samira: thanks bot 1 filing now.

samira: @infra-ops opened ticket INF-2247: "JIT mapping + temporary flag-admin for samira". ETA?

infra-ops: Thanks 1 INF-2247 received. We can grant a 6-hour temp role for staging within 15-30m. For prod access we need manager approval + SSO audit 1 that's a separate flow.

matt: thanks infra-ops. Samira 1 once you have staging admin, please don't change prod toggles unless it's part of an approved rollout.

samira: confirmed. Will only toggle in staging for the demo. Any quick guide on toggling safely?

alice: Quick checklist: 1) Create a flag change plan (what to flip, expected behavior) 2) Run local smoke with staging tokens 3) Use the Console UI -> flags -> canary rollout (10%) 4) Monitor the /observability/flags dashboard for error spikes. I can DM a template.

jeff: adding: if you need a service account to run the canary via CI, ask infra-ops for ff-operator-sa scoped to staging only.

maya: FYI for prod access: engineering leads sign-off + security reviews. If you're expecting prod in first week, talk to your manager and tag me and alice.

infra-ops: INF-2247 update: temp role applied to samira for staging at 1745000150, expires at 1745021750 (6 hours later). Please verify and close ticket when done.

samira: verified, I can see the flags now and toggled a feature to canary 5% 1 dashboard metrics look clean. Thanks everyone! :tada:

matt: awesome. welcome again 1 ping if you hit anything odd.

samira: thanks all, closing thread after I finish the demo prep.
